    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where true outcomes bottom before model catches up",

    "Outcomes consistently trail model forecasts by 1-3 days, showing calculation lag in dynamic systems",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.5) when price is bottoming contradicts model's mean-reversion bias",
    "Model overestimates price levels during uptrends by 0.3-0.7 EUR compared to actual peaks",
    "When sentiment is strongly negative ( <0), model fails to capture bottoming accurately",
    "Price volatility patterns are understated in forecasts, causing systematic underprediction of outcome variance"
